content.text:
I'm on screen 1 and the title is "פיקדון". That's my subject, good.
"כסף שמפקידים בבנק לתקופה מוסכמת, ובתמורה הבנק משלם עליו ריבית". Yes, that's what I do.
"קבועה… או משתנה… בסוף התקופה הכסף חוזר לעו"ש או מתחדש אוטומטית". That's just what the clerk does with mine.
I can't tell what "123 מחקר 123 מחושב 123 הזנה" is supposed to mean.
The black background and grey letters are hard on my eyes.
On the right there's a box with sliders. I'm not touching those.
The big number is "68,270 ₪", and next to it "בכסף של היום".
Further down it says "ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪". So I put in 70,000 and have 68,270 left? That's less than I put in!
The interest is "1.8" and the inflation is "2". So the bank pays less than prices go up? That worries me.
Their example is 10,000 plus 500 a month. That's not me. My money goes in all at once.

Screen 2 has "למה משתמשים בזה". It mentions "קרנות כספיות ומק"מ", so I skip it.
"שווה לדעת" has "מס… 15%", which I understand. "שבירת פיקדון: הסכמת הבנק" sits next to "BANK-06", and I don't know what that is.
Then "אין ביטוח פיקדונות". What does that mean?
Under "כמה זה עולה" it says "דמי יציאה… לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע". There's no number.

Screen 3, "מיסוי", says the bank takes 15% off the interest at the end. Fine.
Then a red box: "שבירת פיקדון לפני הזמן: האתר לא מחשב אותה. הקנס הוא תנאי של הבנק". So taking the money out early costs a fine, and nobody here says how much.
"אם בנק קורס, אין חוק שמחזיר לכם את הכסף". That frightens me, but my bank is a big one.
"פיקדון לא צמוד לא מגן מעליית מחירים." So that's why the number came out smaller.
I'm getting tired. Under "מונחים" every row has the same grey tags, "אתר הגורם המציע", "פרסומת". I only read "קנס שבירה" and "תחנת יציאה" and then I stopped.

input.answer: A fixed deposit is money you give the bank for an agreed time. It pays fixed or changing interest, and 15% of the interest goes to tax. If you need the money before the end, the bank charges a fine that the site doesn't calculate, unless the deposit has an "exit point" (תחנת יציאה). It also doesn't keep up with prices, which is why their example ended at 68,270 after putting in 70,000. I'm not moving anything: I'll ask the clerk how big the fine is and whether there are exit points, and ask my son about that 68,270.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the box 'מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן'
stuck.why: The big number 68,270 is smaller than the 70,000 I put in. I didn't understand whether I lose money or what 'בכסף של היום' means.
It frightened me. Is my money at the bank not safe?

stuck.where: Screen 3, the red box about breaking a deposit
stuck.why: It says there's a fine but not how much. This was exactly what I wanted to know.

Dark background with small grey text that's hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially notes under the boxes and the tax cards

findings.what: The example uses a 10,000 start plus 500 a month, which doesn't fit someone with a lump sum, and changing it needs sliders
Codes in English letters (BANK-06, TXI-03) after the sentences mean nothing to me

The cost table gives no number, only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'
I don't know who runs the site. It isn't a bank.
